title: Refill Cycle and Shipping Charges by Tier (Insulin Pump Program)
content:
Refill cycle figures and shipping charges of the Insulin Pump Program, per tier.

| Tier | Supply days per shipment | Refill reminder lead (days) | Refill ship lead (days) | Refill confirmation required | Standard shipping fee | Free-shipping threshold | Expedited shipping fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pump Self-Pay Program | 30 | 7 | 7 | No (subscription shipping on schedule) | $6.95 | $75.00 | $24.50 |
| Insulin Pump Commercial HMO Program | 30 | 10 | 7 | Yes | $0.00 | $0.00 (always free) | $24.50 |
| Insulin Pump Commercial PPO Program | 90 | 10 | 10 | Yes | $0.00 | $0.00 (always free) | $24.50 |
| Insulin Pump Medicare Advantage Program | 90 | 14 | 10 | Yes | $0.00 | $0.00 (always free) | $24.50 |
| Insulin Pump Original Medicare Program | 90 | 14 | 10 | Yes | $0.00 | $0.00 (always free) | $24.50 |
| Insulin Pump Medicaid Program | 30 | 14 | 7 | Yes | $0.00 | $0.00 (always free) | $24.50 |

## Column definitions

- **Supply days per shipment** — the standard days of supply in one refill shipment, in calendar days (a multiple of 30).
- **Refill reminder lead** — the earliest point for Larkfield's refill-reminder contact, in calendar days before the planned ship date.
- **Refill ship lead** — the earliest point a refill may ship, in calendar days before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of the same item.
- **Refill confirmation required** — whether each refill requires the customer's own confirmation of continued use and quantity on hand before it ships; "No" means subscription shipping on schedule.
- **Standard shipping fee** — the fee for standard ground shipping of a refill below the free-shipping threshold, in US dollars.
- **Free-shipping threshold** — the shipment cash-price total, in US dollars, at or above which standard shipping is free; $0.00 means standard shipping is always free.
- **Expedited shipping fee** — the fee for customer-requested expedited (two-day) shipping, in US dollars; never billed to a payer.

## Worked comparison (hypothetical shipments)

| Hypothetical shipment | Tier | Standard shipping charge |
|---|---|---|
| Cash-price total $74.99 | Self-Pay | $6.95 (below the $75.00 threshold) |
| Cash-price total $75.00 | Self-Pay | $0.00 (the threshold is reached) |
| Any total | Any insured tier | $0.00 |

A 90-day shipment covers three 30-day blocks and a 30-day shipment one block; the PPO, Medicare Advantage and Original Medicare tiers ship 90 days at a time, the other three tiers 30 days.
